lines.directed: We’re going to turn ritual into a direct enactment of nonduality.
Not merely thinking that everything is Śiva.
But arranging every component of worship so that nothing remains conceptually outside him.
And then we’re going to use this very ritual structure to introduce a disciple into the tradition.
But first, we need somewhere to perform the ritual.
And Abhinavagupta begins with an instruction that I absolutely love.

1. Where should you worship? Wherever your bloody heart is happy.
Right.
